sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import qc_series as new_
orig = importlib.import_module('qc_series.','qc_series') if False else None
# reload orig from /tmp/qc_orig
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('orig','/tmp/qc_orig.py')
orig = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(orig)

cases = [
    {"errors":[None,42,"x",[],[],{}] },
]
# direct compare on a battery of hand cases
streams = [
  dict(values=[0,0,0,0,0],timestamps=[1,2,3,4,5],expected_step=1,hard_limit=10),  # clean
  dict(values=[0,0,100,0,0],timestamps=[1,2,3,4,5],expected_step=1,hard_limit=10), # invalid spike
  dict(values=[0,0,8,0,0],timestamps=[1,2,3,4,5],expected_step=1,hard_limit=10),   # severe? 8>=6 moderate
  dict(values=[0,0,12,0,0],timestamps=[1,2,3,4,5],expected_step=1,hard_limit=10),  # 12 severe
  dict(values=[0,0,13,0,0],timestamps=[1,2,3,4,5],expected_step=1,hard_limit=5),   # 13>=5 invalid
  dict(values=[1],timestamps=[5],expected_step=2,hard_limit=10),                    # len1 window self-median
  dict(values=[0,0,0],timestamps=[1,1,2],expected_step=1,hard_limit=10),            # unordered -> error
  dict(values=[0,0],timestamps=[1,2],expected_step=1,hard_limit=10),                # gap? no
]
bad=0
for c in streams:
    a=orig.qc_series(c); b=new_.qc_series(c)
    if a!=b:
        bad+=1; print("MISMATCH",c,"\n orig",a,"\n new ",b)
print("hand cases mismatches:",bad)
